name: Beam of Light
body:
School transmutation [light]; Level arcanist 6, cleric 5, oracle 5, sorcerer 6, wizard 6, warpriest 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range unlimited (see text)
Target personal
Duration instantaneous

DESCRIPTION

You transform into a beam of light and instantly travel into any location you can see.

This travel must be in a straight line, but otherwise you can travel anywhere that light can enter. The range of this travel is limited only by how far the light can travel in your turn, so in practice the range of this spell is limited to about 1 million miles.
